"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Program councils would be established at the national, state and local levels for those who receive government services.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Radical economic and social democracy would dramatically enhance most people’s capacity for self-determination, according to DSA.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Racial, gender, sexual and other forms of oppression are not reducible to economic exploitation, according to DSA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Solidarity among all working people who are ensnared in the capitalist system may be a prerequisite for a strong socialist movement.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialism as radical democracy is more than the emancipation of a single economic class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The democratic socialist project entails addressing a wide range of oppressions in law, culture and society that limit people’s capacity for self-determination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The work of caregiving, which under capitalism falls disproportionately on women—particularly women of color and migrant women—would be publicly supported.",
